# Project-Context-Docs — Type Catalog

The model-facing catalog of project-context doc TYPES. The **discovery**
generator builds this by scanning each type's self-describing frontmatter
(`core/context-doc-types/*.md`). Each type maps to an on-disk doc under
`~/.igris/projects/{project}/context/<target>`.

- **applies_when** = the project-kind/archetype predicate (the contract FR-199's
  presence-enforcement reads: a project of a matching kind missing the `target`
  is a presence violation).
- **consult_when** = when the model should read the doc before working.
- **maintain_when** = the staleness trigger — when a change makes the doc stale.

> Consumers: `/promote` P2 (maps a hardened learning to its `target` doc) and
> `/ground` (authors a `target` from the type's body skeleton).

| type | target | applies_when | consult_when | maintain_when | summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| api_pattern | api_pattern.md | API-bearing projects (exposes or consumes an API — endpoints, RPC, or a typed client) | designing or consuming an endpoint, shaping a request/response, or choosing an API convention | an endpoint convention, request/response shape, or API standard changes | The project's API conventions — endpoint shape, request/response contracts, and integration patterns. |
| architecture_map | architecture_map.md | structural projects (has distinct layers, modules, or boundaries worth mapping) | working across module boundaries, placing new code, or reasoning about how the system fits together | a layer, module boundary, or major structural relationship changes | The project's structure — layers, modules, boundaries, and how the major pieces fit together. |
| coding_guidelines | coding_guidelines.md | all projects (every project has code conventions to follow) | writing or reviewing code, naming things, choosing a pattern, or making a code-level decision | a code convention, naming rule, or reusable pattern changes or is newly agreed | The project's code conventions — naming, structure, idiomatic patterns, and the decisions that shape how code is written. |
| design_system | design_system.md | UI-bearing projects (has a frontend / visual or design surface) | working on UI, components, design tokens, layout, or visual styling | the design language, token set, or component conventions change | The project's visual language — design tokens, components, and layout conventions. |
| test_standards | test_standards.md | testable projects (has automated tests or a test harness) | writing or reviewing tests, choosing what to test, or setting up a test fixture | a testing convention, coverage expectation, or fixture pattern changes | The project's testing conventions — what to test, how tests are structured, and the fixture patterns to follow. |
